allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:8080/ -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; "still up" } catch { "server down" })
